topic: An old haveli in the walled city where a harmonium plays by itself at exactly 3 o'clock every night.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Haveli That Played at Three

shots.narration: That empty haveli played every night, but nobody touched the keys.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated Pakistani courtyard at night, brass lantern between Bashir and Saad, no visible writing.
shots.action: Bashir points toward a distant haveli above the courtyard wall.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, warm lantern glow, deep archway shadows.

shots.narration: Saad asked what happened when I went inside.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard beside the brass lantern, Bashir in brown shawl and white cap, Saad in green hoodie.
shots.mood: Quiet anticipation, lantern light across attentive faces.

shots.narration: [whispers] I reached its door just before three.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, flashback in a narrow fictional Pakistani walled-city lane, weathered haveli doorway, no signs.
shots.action: Bashir pushes the wooden door inward.
shots.mood: Moonlit fog, peeling plaster, darkness beyond the threshold.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, dusty haveli hall, antique clock with a blank unmarked face, hands indicating three.
shots.action: The clock hammer strikes its small bell.
shots.mood: Silver moonlight, motionless cobwebs, oppressive silence.

shots.narration: Across the room, the harmonium opened its bellows.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, empty haveli music room, unbranded wooden harmonium on a faded rug.
shots.action: The harmonium bellows expand without anyone nearby.
shots.mood: Dust suspended in moonlight, black window recesses.

shots.narration: [surprised] Then its keys began pressing themselves.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of the dusty harmonium keyboard, empty space above every key.
shots.action: Several harmonium keys sink in sequence.
shots.mood: Pale highlights on ivory-colored keys, surrounding darkness.

shots.narration: I shut its lid, hoping the music would stop.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, haveli music room, brass lantern resting beside the harmonium.
shots.action: Bashir lowers the harmonium's wooden keyboard cover.
shots.mood: Tense amber light, long shadows across the rug.

shots.narration: Instead, the tune came from my lantern.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, haveli music room, closed harmonium behind Bashir, brass lantern beside his face.
shots.action: Bashir raises the lantern to his ear.
shots.mood: Uneasy recognition, wavering gold light against blue darkness.

shots.narration: [sighs] I brought it home without looking inside.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, flashback in the deserted walled-city lane outside the haveli.
shots.action: Bashir walks away carrying his lantern.
shots.mood: Heavy fog, looming wooden doorway, isolated amber glow.

shots.narration: Beside Saad, the lantern started trembling.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, return to the courtyard, brass lantern on the paving between Bashir and Saad.
shots.action: The lantern trembles on the stone.
shots.mood: Frozen expressions, jittering shadows, cold surrounding darkness.

shots.narration: Inside the glass, tiny keys played beneath the flame.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, extreme close view through lantern glass, miniature harmonium impossibly lodged beneath the burning wick.
shots.action: The miniature harmonium keys press themselves.
shots.mood: Unnatural amber brilliance, warped glass reflections, deepest surrounding black.

shots.narration: [whispers] Tomorrow, we follow its music to the abandoned railway station.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, deserted fictional Pakistani railway station at night, blank walls, empty platform, hanging brass lantern.
shots.action: The hanging lantern swings above the empty tracks.
shots.mood: Moonlit railway fog, distant amber glow, waiting darkness.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, the music leads to an abandoned railway station.
episode.description: Every night at three, a harmonium plays inside an empty haveli in a fictional Pakistani walled city. Bashir Chacha tells Saad what happened when he followed its music—and what followed him home. A fictional spooky story.
